facts.text: The Flashes Go Further Scholarship covers the remaining cost of tuition for up to four years for eligible full-time Kent Campus Ohio undergraduates whose family income on the FAFSA is $75,000 or less.

sources.title: Flashes Go Further Scholarship Program - Kent State University
sources.quote: The Flashes Go Further Scholarship helps make free tuition possible by covering the gap between your grants and scholarships and the full cost of tuition.

sources.title: Flashes Go Further Scholarship Program - Kent State University
sources.quote: Submit the FAFSA annually with a total family income of $75,000 or less.
